actions.title: Delete Entire Receipt (all inventory must be deleted first)

action.message: This is an irreversible transaction. Are you sure you wish to delete this Receipt?
This will print labels for all inventory related to this receipt. Are you sure you wish to continue?

Updating this line may impact the quality of information being aggregated back to your external system. In particular if you modify the Line Quantity or other attributes that are expected by the external system..

fields.label: Supplier Lot Number
fields.description: Incoming lot number - all inventory for this line should be of the same Lot

fields.label: Line Item Quantity:
fields.description: Total quantity of all product being received against this line - IF integrated with external system this is the value that will be passed.

actions.title: Delete Receipt Line (only if no inventory)

action.message: Deleting this Receipt Line - will NOT adjust the associated inventory - Before deleting this you must first adjust or delete the attached inventory records.

actions.title: Print Labels for all Line Related Inventory

action.message: This will print labels for all inventory associated with this receipt line. Are you sure you wish to continue?
